name: print-social-orange-best-agency-post-with-angled-tint-panel
title: 'Best Agency for Your Business' post with an angled orange tint panel over a team photo
whatItIs: A square post with a photo of two smiling colleagues, a translucent orange angled panel on the left carrying a thin-and-bold uppercase headline, a paper-plane logo, an orange quote tab top-right and a white footer with 'Join us' and phone.
whatItMeans: Professional and upbeat; translucent colour keeps the photo visible while branding it.
techniques: Lay a semi-transparent angled panel over the photo.
Alternate light and bold weights line by line.
Balance a top-right tab against a bottom footer.

vocabulary.definition: A see-through colour shape over an image.
Mixing thin and bold type for emphasis.
